core_conclusion: Random-path reachability keeps rising after structured search saturates while the deployable vote remains near baseline.
The random-path oracle advantage is positive in every clean audited cell and survives tested search variations.
Tested answer-blind selectors recover little or none of the oracle-deployment gap.
The recognition-generation failure is bounded in the census and pruning-created cases reproduce MLP-sensitive repair.
One identified MLP block per case is the selective causal locus while within-block effects are not uniformly sparse.
Clean matched RLVR gains come from base-reachable questions while the reachable ceiling remains flat or falls.
Training most often realizes base-reachable questions that the base already samples frequently.
